transcript: the other night I saw Of the Nightingale I Envy the Fate at La Mama This piece is being presented as part of the Under The Radar festival this January and it's a solo piece that offers an interpretation of the death of Cassandra of Greek mythology. although it's primarily movement based I felt like the lighting and sound design were also very distinctive and in a sense their own characters. honestly, otherwise I don't really know exactly how to interpret this piece but I really enjoyed it and I thought it was very cool even if it was out of my realm of understanding. and I kind of get the sense that a lot of the stuff being presented in Under the Radar tends to be very cool and somewhat out there conceptually. so definitely check out this festival if you're around this month and you're looking for cool like non-conventional theater pieces. With that, another program for my collection.
